examples.solution_text:
Both numbers are in scientific notation. Compare the powers first.
$10^{3}<10^{5}$
So $1.6 \times 10^{5}$ is larger, even though its coefficient is smaller.

The powers are equal, so compare the coefficients.
$4.08<4.70$
So $4.7 \times 10^{6}$ is larger.

Compare the powers first. The more negative exponent gives the smaller power of $10$.
$10^{-5}<10^{-3}$
So $7.2 \times 10^{-5}$ is smaller.

Move the decimal point four places right to obtain the coefficient. The original number is small, so the exponent is negative.
$0.000\,62=6.2 \times 10^{-4}$
The powers are now equal, and $6.2>5.9$.
So $0.000\,62$ is larger.

Rewrite the numbers that are not in scientific notation.
$480\,000=4.8 \times 10^{5}$
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}0.045 \times 10^{7}\\&=4.5 \times 10^{-2} \times 10^{7}\\&=4.5 \times 10^{5}\end{aligned}$
All three powers are $10^{5}$, so compare the coefficients: $4.5<4.6<4.8$.
Ascending order is $0.045 \times 10^{7},\ 4.6 \times 10^{5},\ 480\,000$.

Rewrite the numbers that are not in scientific notation.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}16 \times 10^{-3}\\&=1.6 \times 10^{1} \times 10^{-3}\\&=1.6 \times 10^{-2}\end{aligned}$
$0.015=1.5 \times 10^{-2}$
Since $10^{-2}>10^{-3}$, the three numbers with power $10^{-2}$ come first. Their coefficients satisfy $1.7>1.6>1.5$.
Descending order is $1.7 \times 10^{-2},\ 16 \times 10^{-3},\ 0.015,\ 9.4 \times 10^{-3}$.

examples.derivation: The values are 8400 and 160000. Both coefficients are normalised; exponent 5 exceeds exponent 3, so 1.6 × 10^5 is larger. This adapts Mixed Practice Foundation Q1b.
Both numbers have power 10^6. Comparing 4.08 with 4.70 gives 4.08 < 4.70, so 4.7 × 10^6 is larger. This adapts the equal-power comparison in Mixed Practice Foundation Q1a.
The values are 0.000072 and 0.0029. Both are normalised, and −5 < −3, so 7.2 × 10^−5 is smaller. This adapts Mixed Practice Foundation Q2f.

Moving the decimal four places gives coefficient 6.2, hence 0.00062 = 6.2 × 10^−4. Since 6.2 > 5.9 at the same power, 0.00062 is larger. Decimal conversion and mixed-form comparison are supported by the conversion teaching and Mixed Practice Foundation Q3b.

480000 = 4.8 × 10^5. Also 0.045 × 10^7 = 4.5 × 10^−2 × 10^7 = 4.5 × 10^5. Thus 450000 < 460000 < 480000, giving the stated ascending order in original forms. Mixed Practice Foundation Q3a supports this task. The continuation rows have the required phantom equals gutter.

16 × 10^−3 = 1.6 × 10^1 × 10^−3 = 1.6 × 10^−2, and 0.015 = 1.5 × 10^−2. The values satisfy 0.017 > 0.016 > 0.015 > 0.0094, giving the stated descending order. Mixed Practice Foundation Q3b and Q4 support mixed-form ordering; Development Q7 supports normalisation. The continuation rows have the required phantom equals gutter.
